title: HDFC SAP Concur Solutions Prime Corporate credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A SAP Concur Prime corporate card designed for enterprises, offering global acceptance, travel perks, and integration with SAP’s expense solutions.

items.child: 4% off on Flights and Hotels Booking

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Fire and burglary insurance for shops up to ₹5 lakh.|Cash in safe/transit up to ₹25,000.|Electronic equipment insurance (excluding terrorism) up to ₹50,000.|Hospital cash (accident-only) payable per day up to ₹1,000.|Hospital cash (illness-only) payable per day up to ₹1,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Avail Insurance package starting at an annual premium of Rs.3,785 which includes the above.

benefitRows.name: MMT MyBiz
benefitRows.description: 4% off on Flights and Hotels Booking
benefitRows.offer: 4% off on flight and hotel bookings. Discounted fares, free meal and seat selection, and low fees for cancellation.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Book your flights and hotels on MMT MyBiz using HDFC Credit Card.
